GitHub - kasturibuilds/generative-loaders: Accessible React loading states for generative interfaces: streamed text, inline activity, and image generation. · GitHub

name: Generative Loaders
summary: React loader library for AI waiting states: 16 text, 18 inline and 12 image variants across three accessible components.
description: A React component library for the waiting states of generative products: TextLoader for streaming text, InlineLoader for buttons and status rows, and ImageLoader for placeholders while an image generates. 46 named variants in total (16 text, 18 inline, 12 image). React 18+, SSR-safe, accessible by default and published on npm as generative-loaders.
contains: 46 variants: 16 text reveals, 18 inline indicators, 12 image placeholders
streaming-friendly: pass the full response so far, only the new suffix animates
accessible by default (polite live status, respects prefers-reduced-motion)
React 18+, SSR-safe, MIT licensed, npm install generative-loaders
